**Summary:** every reader/writer of the invented `THYROX_CONFIG_HOME` (and every hardcoded `homedir()/.claude` fallback) across the daemon and cli bg surfaces now resolves through `getConfigHomeDir()`, so a fresh install keeps the daemon and job state under the same `~/.thyrox` root as the rest of the client. All touched suites (daemon 129, cli 486, agent 2706, command-runtime 327, smoke 5) pass, and the new `getDaemonHomeDir` test fails when reverted to the old `THYROX_CONFIG_HOME`/`homedir()` form, confirming the control.

One note: `git grep THYROX_CONFIG_HOME -- src tests .env.example` returns non-zero only in the new `socketPaths.test.ts`, which deliberately sets that legacy variable to prove `getDaemonHomeDir()` no longer follows it — that's the requested negative-path test, not a leftover.
